summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by IperionX Ltd, a foreign private issuer, attaching a Technical Report Summary for its Titan Project in Tennessee. The document contains forward-looking statements regarding mineral resource estimates, recoveries, and commodity price assumptions. No special-situation event is present; this is a routine mineral project update filed as a current report under the Exchange Act. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, or other special situation is described. The filing merely satisfies ongoing reporting obligations and does not trigger any of the identified categories.
